missing_functions_for_otdb_apw: 1. High-Current Sinusoidal Thermal-Wave (1w) Excitation Driver: AD5941 excitation amplifier cannot source 17.3 mA RMS (24.4 mA peak) into a 2x200 Ohm Pt100 Wheatstone bridge without clipping and self-heating the AFE die. Requires external AD5683R 16-bit DAC + ADA4522-2 + BC847C emitter-follower buffer.

2. Low-Noise Differential Instrumentation Amplifier for Sub-Millivolt 3w Signal: A 20 um CaCO3 scale layer produces dV_3w = 18.6 uV RMS at the bridge midpoints (1.86 mV after G=100). AD5941's bare PGA (input noise ~25 nV/rtHz + 1/f corner) cannot resolve sub-microvolt 3w steps cleanly. Requires external AD8421BRZ (3.2 nV/rtHz, G=100) feeding AD5941 AIN0.

3. Independent Reference-Arm Contamination Channel (Closing earlier exploratory review Hardware Gap): Rev D only digitized the differential bridge output (Sense - Ref), making symmetric or partial reference-arm fouling unobservable in hardware without an extra channel. Requires a second AD8421BRZ (U2B) measuring BRIDGE_MID_REF against a 2 ppm/K Susumu fixed divider into AD5941 AIN2, plus TMUX1108 routing of IDE_REF into the AD5941 EIS port.

4. Phase-Locked 1w/3w Synchronization: HunStat2's stock firmware runs asynchronous blocking EIS sweeps. Requires RP2040 PIO + DMA timer interrupt at 512 Hz (64x oversampling of f_1w = 8.0 Hz or 512x of f_1w = 1.0 Hz) driving AD5683R SPI updates and phase-locked to AD5941 GPIO0/SYNC sampling.

5. Bipolar Analog Supply Rails (+3.3V_A / -2.5V_A): HunStat2 powers AD5941 solely from USB 3.3V unbuffered rail. Requires ADP7118 (+3.3V_A), ADM8829 inverter, and ADP7182 (-2.5V_A) so bridge op-amps and in-amps have true negative headroom.
